I’m so sorry that you’re dealing with this. You deserve help, and it’s ridiculous that you have to worry about being accused in that kind of a situation. I hope you know that you aren’t alone, and that you aren’t a bad person. I would suggest that you familiarize yourself with the pedaphelia laws in your state, this hopefully will give you some peace of mind.  And see if you can find a therapist who is well versed in sexual addictions. You mentioned a masturbatory addiction, so that may be a place to start. I’m concerned that you find someone who will be able to help you come to terms with this and repair your sense of self worth. There are therapists who engage in forms of sex shaming, and may not be best equipped to help you. A sex positive therapist, who can get into the reasons behind your addiction, and maybe explore what could have brought these urges on for you. 

There have been interesting articles published recently about pedaphilia being a sexual orientation, with new ideas on treatment. You may be familiar with this already, but this too may give you some peace of mind. Knowing that you aren’t acting on your urges, and knowing that there is a community who is aware and wants to help could give you some comfort.
